subject.title: Discord thread reply after session done: silent message loss due to session-store CAS race, no retry unlike Telegram

question: Should this Discord-specific report wait on the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should maintainers also require Discord channel-level retry/requeue or visible-failure parity for `reply session initialization conflicted` errors?
rationale: Current source proves both the shared conflict throw and a Discord retry gap, but choosing shared recovery versus a channel-specific retry loop affects hot channel behavior and session lifecycle ownership.

options.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread replies before adding a Discord-specific retry loop.

options.title: Require Discord Retry Parity Now
options.body: Queue a focused Discord repair that classifies reply-session-init conflicts as retryable and preserves inbound replay keys with bounded backoff or a visible channel failure.

options.title: Ask For Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a current-main Discord thread timing repro before choosing between shared-root and channel-level fixes.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread replies before adding a Discord-specific retry loop.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history on the guarded reply-session initialization boundary where the owner-boundary decision sits.
